Name: DE-Capacity
Description: Extracts capacity of the users considering their working days, holidays, vacations, and time per day they have to input. It also considers if the user is inactive.
Statement:
with
lev as
(
    select  uiv.[User] as UserId,
            cast(lev.Day as date) as Day,
            sum(iif(lvt.LeavesInHours = 1, isnull(lev.TotalMinutes, 0) / 60.0, iif(lev.HalfDay = 0, usr.LeaveDayHours, usr.LeaveDayHours / 2.0))) as LeaveHours
    from    UserVacation lev
                join UserInfoVacation uiv on uiv.Oid = lev.UserInfoVacation
                join UserVacationType lvt on lvt.Oid = uiv.UserVacationType
                join [User] usr on usr.Oid = uiv.[User]
    where   lev.RequestedApproval = 1 and
            lev.State in (3, 5)
    group by uiv.[User], cast(lev.Day as date)
),
dwl as
(
    select  dw.[User] as UserId,
            cast(dw.DayUtc as date) as Day,
            sum(dw.Workload) as WorkloadHours
    from    DailyWorkload dw
    where   dw.DocumentTypeName = 'Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Deliverable' and
            dw.GCRecord is null
    group by dw.[User], cast(dw.DayUtc as date)
),
res as
(
    select  UserId,
            string_agg(cast(ResponsibleId as nvarchar(max)), ', ') within group (order by ResponsibleId) as ResponsibleIds,
            string_agg(cast(isnull(Responsible, '') as nvarchar(max)), ', ') within group (order by ResponsibleId) as Responsibles,
            string_agg(cast(ResponsibleHasImage as nvarchar(max)), ', ') within group (order by ResponsibleId) as ResponsibleHasImages
    from    (
                select  distinct
                        ure.[User] as UserId,
                        usl.Id as ResponsibleId,
                        usl.Name as Responsible,
                        isnull(usl.HasImage, 0) as ResponsibleHasImage
                from    UserResponsible ure
                            join UserLookup usl on usl.Id = ure.Responsible
                where   ure.GCRecord is null and
                        ure.UserResponsibleType = 1
            ) t
    group by UserId
),
dat as
(
    select  usr.Oid as DocumentOid,
            usr.Oid as UserId,
            usr.Name as [User],
            usr.HasImage as UserHasImage,
            cast(isnull(usl.IsActive, 0) as bit) as IsActive,
            res.ResponsibleIds,
            res.Responsibles,
            res.ResponsibleHasImages,
            dep.Oid as DepartmentId,
            dep.Name as Department,
            div.Oid as DivisionId,
            div.Name as Division,
            com.Oid as CompanyId,
            com.Name as Company,
            com.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
            cast(yrd.Day as date) as Day,
            usr.RequiredHours,
            usr.Plannable as IsPlannable,
            ust.Oid as TypologyId,
            ust.Name as Typology,
            utg.Oid as TypologyGroupId,
            utg.Name as TypologyGroup,
            cast(iif((isnull(usr.Monday, 0) = 0 and isnull(usr.Tuesday, 0) = 0 and isnull(usr.Wednesday, 0) = 0 and isnull(usr.Thursday, 0) = 0 and isnull(usr.Friday, 0) = 0 and isnull(usr.Saturday, 0) = 0 and isnull(usr.Sunday, 0) = 0 and datename(weekday, yrd.Day) in ('Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday')) or (datename(weekday, yrd.Day) = 'Monday' and usr.Monday = 1) or (datename(weekday, yrd.Day) = 'Tuesday' and usr.Tuesday = 1) or (datename(weekday, yrd.Day) = 'Wednesday' and usr.Wednesday = 1) or (datename(weekday, yrd.Day) = 'Thursday' and usr.Thursday = 1) or (datename(weekday, yrd.Day) = 'Friday' and usr.Friday = 1) or (datename(weekday, yrd.Day) = 'Saturday' and usr.Saturday = 1) or (datename(weekday, yrd.Day) = 'Sunday' and usr.Sunday = 1), 1, 0) as bit) as IsWorkingDay,
            cast(iif(hdy.Holiday is null, 0, 1) as bit) as IsHoliday,
            hdy.Holiday,
            isnull(lev.LeaveHours, 0) as LeaveHours,
            isnull(dwl.WorkloadHours, 0) as WorkloadHours
    from    [User] usr
                join Department dep on dep.Oid = usr.Department
                join Division div on div.Oid = dep.Division
                join Company com on com.Oid = div.Company
                join UserLookup usl on usl.Id = usr.Oid
                join YearDay yrd on 1 = 1
                join UserTypology ust on ust.Oid = usr.Typology
                left join UserTypologyGroup utg on utg.Oid = ust.UserTypologyGroup
                left join res on res.UserId = usr.Oid
                left join lev on lev.UserId = usr.Oid and lev.Day = cast(yrd.Day as date)
                left join dwl on dwl.UserId = usr.Oid and dwl.Day = cast(yrd.Day as date)
                outer apply
                (
                    select  string_agg(cast(hol.Name as nvarchar(max)), ', ') as Holiday
                    from    Holiday hol
                    where   cast(hol.Date as date) = cast(yrd.Day as date) and
                            (hol.Company is null or hol.Company = com.Oid)
                ) hdy
    where   (usr.StartDate is null or cast(yrd.Day as date) >= cast(usr.StartDate as date)) and
            (usr.ExpirationDate is null or cast(yrd.Day as date) <= cast(usr.ExpirationDate as date)) and
            (usl.InactivatedOnUtc is null or cast(yrd.Day as date) <= cast(usl.InactivatedOnUtc as date)) and
            (usl.InactivatedOnUtc is not null or usl.IsActive = 1)
)
select  DocumentOid,
        UserId,
        [User],
        UserHasImage,
        IsActive,
        ResponsibleIds,
        Responsibles,
        ResponsibleHasImages,
        DepartmentId,
        Department,
        DivisionId,
        Division,
        CompanyId,
        Company,
        CompanyHasImage,
        Day,
        RequiredHours,
        IsPlannable,
        TypologyId,
        Typology,
        TypologyGroupId,
        TypologyGroup,
        IsWorkingDay,
        IsHoliday,
        Holiday,
        LeaveHours,
        WorkloadHours,
        iif(IsWorkingDay = 1 and IsHoliday = 0, RequiredHours, 0) as WorkingCapacityHours,
        iif(IsWorkingDay = 0 or IsHoliday = 1, 0, iif(RequiredHours - LeaveHours - WorkloadHours < 0, 0, RequiredHours - LeaveHours - WorkloadHours)) as CapacityHours,
        iif(LeaveHours + WorkloadHours - iif(IsWorkingDay = 1 and IsHoliday = 0, RequiredHours, 0) > 0, LeaveHours + WorkloadHours - iif(IsWorkingDay = 1 and IsHoliday = 0, RequiredHours, 0), 0) as OverAllocatedHours
from    dat

Use when the user asks about user capacity, remaining availability, over-allocation or resource planning by day, user, department, division, company, typology and typology group or responsible user.
